description.en: BioSecBench-Surveillance evaluates AI agents on pathogen genomic surveillance across 100 tasks spanning seven categories, including taxonomic classification and genetic-engineering detection. Agents receive raw sequencing data and surveillance context, and their structured answers are graded deterministically against ground truth.

claire_radar.whyItMatters: The benchmark addresses the lack of verifiable evaluation for AI agents in genomic surveillance, where analysis bottlenecks are emerging as data generation scales. It provides a standardized measure of agent reliability in critical public health applications, with practical value in assessing whether agents can be trusted for real-world outbreak response.
